declarations.description:
Experimental DOCX editing surface. The engine owns only the stable, empty light-DOM child
slotted into the document area. Import the companion's `docx/editor.css` separately for engine
content styling. A disconnect destroys the session, including undo history and selection;
callers reopen their own saved bytes after reconnect. Save returns bytes without persisting or
clearing dirty state; call `acknowledgeSaved()` after durable host persistence.
declarations.name: LyraDocxEditor

members.name: readOnly
members.description: Applied when the next document is opened. The session fixes this value at creation.

members.name: toolbarPlacement
members.description: Expose the toolbar area and workspace as items in the parent layout, or keep them together inline.

members.name: toolbarLayout
members.description: Fit both tool rows together when space permits, or explicitly choose one or two rows.

members.name: density
members.description: Spacing and sizing of toolbar and navigation controls.

members.name: fileActions
members.description: Space-separated toolbar buttons in the order New, Open, Save. An empty list hides the group.

members.name: documentToolsPlacement
members.description: Place document navigation tools above the toolbar or after insertion tools in its first row.

members.name: zoom
members.description: Page zoom: `fit` follows the available width, or a factor from 0.25 to 4. Presentation only.

members.name: snapshot
members.description: Current immutable session state, or null before opening and after disconnect.

members.name: open
members.description: Open caller-owned DOCX bytes or a local file. Replacing dirty content can be vetoed.

members.name: openUrl
members.description:
Download and open a DOCX document. Opt-in: the element never fetches on its own. The URL must be
relative, HTTP(S), `blob:` or `data:`; it resolves against the document base URL and is requested
with the owner window's `fetch()` and same-origin credentials. The response is read with the 16 MiB
input ceiling, then admitted like any other bytes. A newer open, new document or disconnect cancels
the request. Failures show the localized error state; `fetch-failed` covers network errors and
non-OK responses, `invalid-option` an unsafe URL.

members.name: newDocument
members.description: Create a blank document. Replacing dirty content can be vetoed.

members.name: can
members.description:
Whether `command` can run against the current selection, with a reason when it cannot;
reports `not-ready` until a document has loaded.

members.name: execute
members.description: Prepare and execute a supported formatting, editing or history command. Await the result before inspecting state.

members.name: paragraphStyles
members.description: Inspect paragraph styles in the open document on demand.

members.name: fontFamilies
members.description: Inspect candidate font families on demand; this does not load font assets.

members.name: imageDescription
members.description: Read complete bounded title and description from the settled image cache, without changing selection.

members.name: selectImage
members.description: Select an eligible body image in document order, wrapping without changing document content.

members.name: canInsertImage
members.description: Cached advisory caret availability; insertion verifies the package and exact original intent.

members.name: insertImage
members.description: Insert owned raster bytes at the original plain body caret. A committed original result survives replacement.

members.name: find

type.text: { matchCase?: boolean; wholeWord?: boolean; limit?: number }

members.description: Search the current revision without changing document content.

members.name: selectMatch
members.description: Navigate to a revision-stamped result of the latest search.

members.name: replaceMatch
members.description: Replace one match, including deletion with an empty string.

members.name: save
members.description: Serialize explicitly; persistence is owned by the caller.

members.name: exportBytes
members.description: Serialize caller-owned DOCX bytes while preserving any pending save receipt.

members.name: acknowledgeSaved
members.description: Mark a genuine save receipt persisted by the host.

members.name: focusEditor
members.description: Return keyboard focus to the editing surface.

members.name: openCommands
members.description: Open searchable commands for this editor, retaining the original document selection.

members.name: canReplaceImage
members.description: Advisory eligibility for byte replacement of the selected plain inline image.

members.name: replaceImage
members.description: Replace image bytes while preserving its original dimensions and descriptions.

members.name: outline
members.description: Read a bounded body heading outline without editing or exporting.

members.name: selectOutlineItem
members.description: Navigate to a current authentic outline id without editing.

members.name: readFragment
members.description: Read a bounded slice of top-level body blocks with revision-scoped paragraph ids.

members.name: selectionBlock
members.description: Read the current selection head's top-level body block at the expected revision.

members.name: selectFragmentBlock
members.description: Move the caret to the start of a current fragment paragraph without editing.

members.name: applyEdits
members.description:
Apply an ordered batch of formatting steps at an expected revision, all or nothing, as one revision.
A refusal names the failing step; the document is then unchanged. Await the result before inspecting state.

members.name: inspectDocument
members.description: Inspect bounded body metadata; this is not an accessibility certification.

members.name: selectDiagnostic
members.description: Navigate to an authentic current diagnostic location without editing.

members.name: review
members.description: Read bounded comments and tracked changes without changing the document.

members.name: selectReviewItem
members.description: Navigate to a current authentic review item without editing.

events.description: Cancelable New from the toolbar or command palette. Fires before confirmation or blank document creation.

events.description: Cancelable Open from the toolbar or command palette. Fires before confirmation or the native file picker.

events.description: Cancelable when a document with unsaved content would be replaced; an untouched or emptied single blank page is replaced without asking.
events.name: lr-before-open

events.description: Materialized, repainted or evicted page indexes after painted body paragraphs receive their current data-lr-block-index.
events.name: lr-paint

events.description: Session state or revision changed; no document bytes are included.
events.name: lr-change

events.description: A normalized refusal code; no document contents are exposed. `destroyed` reports a session lost while connected.
events.name: lr-error

events.description: Explicit save completed; detail contains the save receipt and bytes.
events.name: lr-save
